tasks.label: Build: Hitster Custom Cards XAPK
tasks.detail: Reconstruit le XAPK patché depuis original\HITSTER (4.1.0).xapk

tasks.label: Install only: current XAPK (adb)
tasks.detail: Installe directement output/HITSTER-4.1.0-custom-cards.xapk sur l'appareil connecté, sans reconstruction.
args: $xapk='output/HITSTER-4.1.0-custom-cards.xapk'; if(-not (Test-Path $xapk)){throw "XAPK introuvable: $xapk"}; $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'hitster-custom-install'; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::ExtractToDirectory((Resolve-Path $xapk).Path, $tmp); $apks=@((Join-Path $tmp 'nl.jumbo.hitster.apk'))+(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $tmp 'config.*.apk') | ForEach-Object FullName); $adb=(Get-Command adb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if(-not $adb){$sdk=if($env:ANDROID_HOME){$env:ANDROID_HOME}else{Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk'}; $adb=Join-Path $sdk 'platform-tools\adb.exe'}; if(-not (Test-Path $adb)){throw "adb introuvable: $adb"}; & $adb install-multiple -r $apks; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "adb a echoue (code $LASTEXITCODE)"}; exit 0

tasks.label: Build + Install: connected device (adb)
tasks.detail: Reconstruit le XAPK puis l'installe sur l'appareil adb connecté.
args: $xapk='output/HITSTER-4.1.0-custom-cards.xapk'; if(-not (Test-Path $xapk)){throw "XAPK introuvable: $xapk"}; $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'hitster-custom-install'; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::ExtractToDirectory((Resolve-Path $xapk).Path, $tmp); $apks=@((Join-Path $tmp 'nl.jumbo.hitster.apk'))+(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $tmp 'config.*.apk') | ForEach-Object FullName); $adb=(Get-Command adb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if(-not $adb){$sdk=if($env:ANDROID_HOME){$env:ANDROID_HOME}else{Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk'}; $adb=Join-Path $sdk 'platform-tools\adb.exe'}; if(-not (Test-Path $adb)){throw "adb introuvable: $adb"}; & $adb install-multiple -r $apks; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "adb a echoue (code $LASTEXITCODE)"}; exit 0

tasks.label: Clean: temporary build files
tasks.detail: Supprime decoded/, extracted/ et les APK intermédiaires (garde le XAPK final).
args: $paths = @('decoded','extracted','output\signed','output\splits','output\nl.jumbo.hitster.modified.apk'); foreach ($p in $paths) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Recurse -Force } }; Write-Host 'Temporary build files removed.'
